## Intent

Ship a provider-neutral `SagaDrivePerformanceFaceV2` character capability contract,
deterministic validator + DE human-readable report, Standard/Premium negotiation
composed with LiveAct Caps V1, and public authoring/import documentation — without
breaking ARKit-only assets or Modular Avatar GLB V1, and without #451 Premium E2E.
